description: Full text of one opinion by opinion id, plus metadata. The text is the best stored text extracted from the mirror (HTML stripped; body_source names the extraction source and fallback_used flags a lower-precedence one), bounded to 200k characters with truncated and text_available flags. Not live CourtListener, not legal advice, and no treatment, "good law" or citation-validity status. Responses carry body_as_of, body_pending (state, exact count, read_at) and body_note, which say when the stored opinion text is older than the case records while a refresh is written; a count that could not be read makes an empty result inconclusive. body_pending_note, when present, says whether this text is the older build or not yet written. Every response carries a "note" stating that response’s source and coverage limits.
